name: Puch AI MCP Starter
description: A starter template for creating MCP servers that work with Puch AI, including built-in tools for job searching (analyze descriptions, fetch postings, search opportunities) and basic image processing. Features bearer token authentication and ready-to-deploy setup for extending Puch AI with custom tools.
